data.body:
Closing (2026-08-07). R1, R3 and R5 landed and merged; acceptance criteria remediated to what was actually delivered and decided, per the operator's standing ruling that an unmeetable criterion is a defect in the criterion.

Merged: 1507 (R5, holder named on timeout), 1508 (R1, one directory-scoped walk), 1510 (R3, lock-polite compact-on-close) — each LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.

Two criteria were rewritten rather than force-ticked. The original AC1 described R2 (hoist the ledger OUT of the lock), a fix that was considered and DECLINED — R1 makes the work fast enough (~1.0s) that keeping it inside preserves atomicity for free, avoiding a race where a stale ledger omits a folded signed event and breaks verify-authorship. The original AC2 asked for 'pid + worktree'; R5 was scoped by the operator to EXISTING stamp machinery, which records host/ns/pid/start.

Not closed over: the write-loss finding (6/6 concurrent comments lost at the 60s timeout) is real and unfixed, and is now owned by 10c3-5a33-2e25-4584 along with the un-run post-R1 re-measurement — at ~1s holds the timeout may be unreachable in practice, which should be measured before building anything. Per-ticket locking stays a future consideration for a second round. Two minor original items (documenting the shared-store topology, sweeping .tmp-event-* residue) are recorded as unowned in the description rather than dropped.
